entities.summary: Peter Ernst, Graf von Mansfeld, or simply Ernst von Mansfeld, was a German military commander. Despite being a Catholic, he fought for the Protestants during the early years of the Thirty Years' War. He was one of the leading mercenary generals of the early war.
